subject: Ferndale Labs onboarding: payment window sync & quick-pay proposal
body:
From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@ferndalelabs.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@ferndalelabs.com
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: payment window question for Ferndale

Hi Irene,

Thank you for the onboarding checklist you sent last week. One quick question from procurement: our standard vendor terms are Net 60 but we generally accelerate payment for strategic suppliers when possible. We wanted to confirm Redwood's billing cadence and whether you can support Net 45 or Net 30 for Ferndale. If Net 30 is possible, we can discuss a quick-pay fee to shorten the window for the first two invoices to expedite vendor cash flow.

Can you confirm a path forward and any paperwork we should fill out to switch the payment lane?

Best,
Lena Torres
Head of Procurement | Ferndale Labs
---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Torres <lena.torres@ferndalelabs.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment window question for Ferndale

Hi Lena — thanks for flagging. Happy to map out options. Short answer: yes, we can support Net 45 and Net 30 for onboarding partners, but there are two operational paths depending on how Ferndale wants to handle the first month of activity:

- Net 45 (standard onboarding change): we update the PO template and vendor record; payments run on our normal net45 cycle. Minimal paperwork (vendor profile + PO header alignment).
- Net 30 or accelerated remit (quick-pay pilot): finance will need an approved quick-pay addendum which documents the fee (%), the invoices covered, and the PO/GL mappings. We can pilot this for the first two invoices and then revert to agreed cadence or roll out more broadly.

I've attached the Ferndale onboarding form (ferndale_onboarding_form.pdf) and a pre-filled PO template (PO_Template_Ferndale.csv) to make the changes quicker.

If you want to pilot quick-pay, please confirm the fee Ferndale proposes and which invoices (e.g., first 2) should be accelerated. I'll loop in David for fee/approval sizing and Monica (CS ops) for PO intake.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
---

From: Sam Brooks <sam.brooks@ferndalelabs.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Lena Torres <lena.torres@ferndalelabs.com>, procurement@ferndalelabs.com
Date: 2027-02-20T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment window question for Ferndale

Irene — thanks. We can do a pilot: Ferndale proposes a 1.5% quick-pay fee to move Net 45 invoices to Net 10 for the first two invoices only. That gives our suppliers the cash sooner and helps smooth our initial month of spend.

We will sign a short addendum and provide PO 100548 for the first contract. Attach me the required addendum language and any PO header info you need.

Sam Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager | Ferndale Labs
---

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Brooks <sam.brooks@ferndalelabs.com>, Lena Torres <lena.torres@ferndalelabs.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-20T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment window question for Ferndale

Sam / Lena — appreciate the proposal and the clarity on scope. A couple of quick notes from finance:

1) Fee sizing: 1.5% to move an invoice from Net 45 to Net 10 for two invoices is within our acceptable band for a pilot. We'll document as a short-form addendum (quickpay_terms_v1.docx).
2) Approval: I'll need the signed PO (100548) and the vendor onboarding form completed to change the vendor record. That ensures payments route to the correct remit account.
3) Accounting treatment: the quick-pay fee will be recorded as a cash discount/expense in the month the payment posts. We will invoice Ferndale a single combined net of fees or present the accelerated payment as a remittance instruction — whichever you prefer.

Action items for Ferndale: please return the completed onboarding form and the signed PO, confirm the two invoices' invoice numbers to accelerate (or indicate 'first two invoices'), and confirm whether you prefer Redwood to include the quick-pay fee on our invoice or have it deducted before remittance.

Irene / Monica — once they return materials we can kick off vendor record changes and queue the first accelerated ACH.

Regards,
David Kim
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
---

From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@ferndalelabs.com>
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sam.brooks@ferndalelabs.com, procurement@ferndalelabs.com
Date: 2027-02-21T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment window question for Ferndale

Thanks David — we completed the onboarding form and signed PO 100548 (attached). For the quick-pay pilot: please accelerate the first two invoices (we'll label them on our side as INV-0001 and INV-0002). Ferndale prefers the quick-pay fee to be invoiced by Redwood as an itemized billing line (so our AP book matches).

I've attached the filled onboarding form (ferndale_onboarding_form.pdf) and the signed PO (PO_100548_signed.pdf). Let me know if you need bank details or additional identification to set up the remit account.

Best,
Lena
---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Torres <lena.torres@ferndalelabs.com>, david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-22T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: payment window question for Ferndale

Lena — received the signed PO and onboarding form, thanks. Quick status update and next steps:

1) Vendor record: I updated the vendor profile in our procurement system and set the preferred payment cadence to Net 45 pending pilot.
2) Quick-pay addendum: David has uploaded quickpay_terms_v1.docx to the shared onboarding folder (link below). Please review; it mirrors the 1.5% fee and lists INV-0001 / INV-0002 as the accelerated invoices.
3) Payments ops: once INV-0001 posts, finance will process the accelerated ACH to Net 10 terms. We will include the quick-pay fee itemized on our invoice, per your preference.
4) PO mapping & remittance: small ask — could you confirm the remit account name and ACH routing? If you prefer to send via secure portal, we can accept bank details via our vendor portal (link).

Links: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4821 and https://drive.google.com/ferndale/onboard/12345 (contains onboarding artifacts, addendum draft, and PO template).

Attachments referenced: ferndale_onboarding_form.pdf (received), PO_Template_Ferndale.csv (updated), quickpay_terms_v1.docx (draft).

We’ll queue the request for expedited payment and keep you posted on timing. If everything looks good on your side, Sam — please confirm the remit details and we’ll schedule the first accelerated ACH.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
